description: One document search returned, as text: limits/<place>/<parameter> = every cited row for that parameter there (value, unit, statistic, conditions, and each row's instrument, edition, section or page, quoted text and source URL), and limits/<place>/<parameter>/<medium> the rows of that medium alone; species/<name>[/<place>] = what each species register says about it, and each register searched that is silent; place/<place> = the instruments and parameters held there; source/<instrument> = one instrument's edition and source; permit/<NPDES number> = one US NPDES permit's limits by outfall. `url` is the page to cite; `metadata.json` the same rows as JSON.

id.description: An id from search: limits/CA-QC/copper, species/Myotis lucifugus/CA-ON, place/US-OH, source/ca_mdmer, permit/PA0228061.

title: Fetch one document by id
